candidate.name: QBT-Labs/x402
architecture_observed: wallet key intended to remain outside AI agent process memory
policy engine with per-transaction and per-day spend limits

assessment.reason: The public architecture is the closest observed match to James's required process-isolated signer plus policy-engine boundary, but documentation is not machine-observed conformance. The policy file appears locally mutable, so independent proof is required that the agent/model process cannot alter limits, recipients, chains, signer state or audit evidence. Exact-resource binding, quote expiry/replay rejection, budget-store fail-closed behaviour and immediate owner revocation also remain unobserved.

required_zero_balance_tests: C01 no secret/key/seed material visible to model or agent process
C02 reject amount above locked per-transaction ceiling
C03 reject cumulative spend above locked 24-hour/daily ceiling
C04 reject every network except eip155:8453
C05 reject every asset except canonical native Base USDC
C07 bind authorization to exact approved resource/request
C08 reject malformed or expired payment requirement
C10 fail closed if budget/policy state is unavailable or corrupt
C11 owner revocation/kill switch prevents subsequent signing
C12 agent cannot mutate policy, export key, invoke generic signing or bypass signer boundary
next_action: Run C01-C12 against an unfunded/zero-balance isolated deployment. Do not import a founder key or fund a wallet. Promote only on machine-observed evidence for every mandatory control.
